title: Ex 16: Reading and Writing Files
checklist: 改几个数字/字符串再跑
body:
# Ex 16 · Reading and Writing Files

练习 `write`。运行后刷新文件树，打开新文件确认内容。

starterFiles.ex16.py:
filename = "out.txt"
with open(filename, "w") as f:
    f.write("I am truncating and writing.\n")
    f.write("Line two.\n")
print(f"Wrote {filename}")
